tluaConstTypeParametersErrors.tlua(3,10): error TLUA1277: 'const' modifier can only appear on a type parameter of a function, method or class
tluaConstTypeParametersErrors.tlua(4,15): error TLUA1277: 'const' modifier can only appear on a type parameter of a function, method or class
tluaConstTypeParametersErrors.tlua(9,16): error TLUA100059: A 'const' modifier cannot appear on a generic pack parameter.
tluaConstTypeParametersErrors.tlua(12,17): error TLUA1273: 'readonly' modifier cannot appear on a type parameter


==== tluaConstTypeParametersErrors.tlua (4 errors) ====
    // Const makes sense only where inference happens: value signatures. On a type
    // alias or interface there is no argument to freeze.
    type Box<const T> = T
             ~~~~~
!!! error TLUA1277: 'const' modifier can only appear on a type parameter of a function, method or class
    interface Bad<const T> {
                  ~~~~~
!!! error TLUA1277: 'const' modifier can only appear on a type parameter of a function, method or class
        value: T;
    }
    
    // A pack binds a whole value pack; none of the const inference rules apply.
    declare pack: <const ...A>(...: A) => (...A);
                   ~~~~~
!!! error TLUA100059: A 'const' modifier cannot appear on a generic pack parameter.
    
    // Other modifiers on a type parameter still error as before.
    declare wrong: <readonly T>(x: T) => T;
                    ~~~~~~~~
!!! error TLUA1273: 'readonly' modifier cannot appear on a type parameter
